body_markdown:
Today, Under Armour and Amazon Music announced Amazon Music Presents: Parker McCollum Honoring Veterans Day, Live from Texas, a special concert by multi-platinum country music star and recent ACM Album of the Year winner Parker McCollum. Created together with Under Armour’s UA Freedom platform, the performance will take place on November 10 in Austin, TX in front of a hometown crowd of active military members and veterans, their families and UA Freedom guests.


The intimate performance will welcome a live audience to one of Austin’s most iconic music venues, Austin City Limits (ACL) Live at The Moody Theater, while viewers everywhere can tune in to the show in[real time at 8:00 PM CT on Amazon Music](https://music.amazon.com/live/events/LDN9VNT63O) , Prime Video, and Twitch.


In celebration of Veterans Day, this concert carries a special meaning for McCollum, a longtime advocate for the military community. As the new face of UA Freedom – Under Armour’s platform and product line that supports military members, veterans, first responders and their families – he is continuing his commitment to honor those who have dedicated their lives in service of this country.
